title: Framework Placement Bench
summary: Place twelve pieces of game state into Unreal's six framework classes, watch the ownership tree fill in as you go, then run every placement through five situations at once — solo PIE, a client reading it, the pawn dying, another player looking, and a level change.
why: Nearly every wrong placement survives a single-player test. Score kept on the Pawn, settings kept on the GameMode, match state read straight off the GameMode — all of it works in PIE with one player and nothing dying, and all of it breaks the first time a real client connects. Grading against one situation is exactly what hides the bug.
